reconcile.note: Matthew Henry treats the Lord's Prayer as God's own remedy for the very ignorance Paul names in Romans, not a rival claim about whether believers know how to pray.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible treats Jesus's prayer instruction in Matthew as flatly inconsistent with Paul's admission that believers do not know what to pray for.

sides.snippet: Pray like this: 'Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.
sides.verseText: Pray like this: 'Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

sides.snippet: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don't know how to pray as we ought.
sides.verseText: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don't know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can't be uttered.
